title: Deposit, Card and Final Balance Figures by Window Series
content:
# Deposit, Card and Final Balance Figures — Window Replacement Contracts

These are the money figures each Ridgeline window series sets for deposits, card payments, the final balance and late balances on a Window Replacement Contracts contract.

## Booking deposit and card figures

| Series | Deposit percentage (cash, check or card) | Deposit minimum (cash, check or card) | Financed deposit percentage (Ridgeline financing, no floor) | Deposit window (calendar days after signing) | Largest single card payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 30% | $450.00 | 0% | 5 | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 30% | $500.00 | 0% | 5 | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 35% | $600.00 | 10% | 5 | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 40% | $750.00 | 10% | 5 | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 40% | $850.00 | 15% | 5 | $15000.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 50% | $1000.00 | 15% | 5 | $15000.00 |

## Final balance and late balance figures

| Series | Final balance due (calendar days after installation completion) | Late balance monthly rate (per full 30-day period) | Smallest late balance charge for a period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 5 | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 5 | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 5 | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 5 | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 5 | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 5 | 1.5% | $15.00 |

## Notes on the figures

- The deposit percentage and deposit minimum are the cash, check or card figures; the financed deposit percentage is the figure for a contract whose payment method is Ridgeline financing, and no floor applies to it. A financed percentage of 0% means no deposit share.
- The deposit window is a count of calendar days after the contract signing date.
- The card figure is the largest single card payment accepted toward one contract.
- The late balance monthly rate is a decimal share per full 30-day period (1.5% is 0.015), and the smallest late balance charge is a dollar floor for a period.

## Hypothetical illustration

At a hypothetical deposit percentage of 20% (a figure no series uses), a hypothetical $20,000 contract value gives a percentage amount of $4,000 (20% of $20,000).
